key_highlights: Massive equity selloff wipes $169B from the Australian sharemarket amid mounting macro pressure.
Cumulative RBA rate hikes severely curtail household borrowing power and accelerate the housing downturn.
Australian dollar depreciation intensifies imported cost pressures while cushioning USD-earning commodity exporters.
Discretionary retail distress deepens as David Jones cuts 1,700 staff, creating market share opportunities for Myer (MYR.AX).
Targeted optimism in resource capital markets driven by gold restarts and rare earths metallurgical breakthroughs.

sectors.trend: Resilience in gold exploration and critical minerals recovery amidst weak AUD/USD tailwinds.
sectors.implications: USD-denominated earnings shield major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX), while gold restarts (FRS.AX) and rare earths innovators attract capital.

sectors.trend: Severe credit pressure from declining borrowing power, falling house prices, and governance liabilities.
sectors.implications: Asset quality risks and slowed mortgage book growth impact major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX); NAB faces conflict-of-interest audit fallout.

sectors.trend: Structural stress in department stores alongside dietary shifts from GLP-1 weight-loss drugs and ACCC retail scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Myer (MYR.AX) gains share as David Jones restructures; supermarket giants (COL.AX, WOW.AX) face regulatory pushback and shifting consumer demand.

sectors.trend: Grid vulnerability highlighted by major blackouts, while COP31 negotiations deadlocked on fossil fuel transitions.
sectors.implications: Heightened capital expenditure scrutiny on Snowy Hydro 2.0 and transition assets; baseline support for oil and gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX).

sectors.trend: Sharpening property downturn as rate hikes degrade purchasing power and Sydney home values tumble.
sectors.implications: Valuation write-downs and margin compression for residential developers and diversified REITs (DXS.AX, MGR.AX, SGP.AX).

sectors.trend: Rapid uptake of GLP-1 therapies altering consumer behavior, alongside government inquiries into peptide regulations.
sectors.implications: Underlying strength in biotech leaders (CSL.AX), balanced against compliance risks for unregulated wellness clinics.

sectors.trend: AI-driven corporate rationalisation causing hiring freezes and offshoring, counterbalanced by surging private AI valuations.
sectors.implications: Enterprise productivity gains contrast with tighter domestic corporate tech budgets, affecting mid-cap tech providers (XRO.AX, WTC.AX).

key_themes: Monetary policy lag and housing contraction weighing heavily on domestic growth.
Extreme equity market de-risking after a $169B weekly capitalization loss.
AUD weakness acting as a shock absorber for mining exporters but feeding domestic inflation.
Retail bifurcation driven by discretionary wallet shrinkage and competitor displacement.
Energy transition bottlenecks stemming from infrastructure reliability issues and COP31 policy gridlock.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA Overtightening and Housing Asset Deflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic credit, retail banking, and residential property developers; preserve cash liquidity.
Increase portfolio weighting to offshore revenue earners, global miners, and gold producers.
Rotate exposure toward institutions with lower regulatory remediation overhead and clean audit governance.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Grid Instability and Energy Transition Capex Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive utility assets with regulated rate bases over high-risk, capital-intensive transition projects.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Producers and Near-Term Restarts
opportunities.rationale: High operating margins propelled by a suppressed AUD/USD and heightened safe-haven appeal following equity drawdowns.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Retail Consolidation in Department Stores
opportunities.rationale: Myer positioned to capture supplier relationships, market share, and foot traffic from downsizing competitor David Jones.
Superior metallurgy breakthroughs (98% rare earths recovery) lower processing cost hurdles and attract ECM funding.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Rate-Sensitive Major Banks and Housing REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Substantial erosion in mortgage borrowing capacity and rapid residential price drops heighten provisioning and credit risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement Downside Index Protection on Benchmark Equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Severe market breadth deterioration ($169B erased) warrants tactical index put options or reduced equity beta.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish 1–3 month outlook for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as persistent RBA hawkishness, housing deterioration, and wealth destruction weigh on sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral 6–12 month outlook as eventual monetary pause, cheapened currency, and resources resilience establish valuation support.

COP31 fossil fuel resolution and domestic climate policy implementation
